response.original_title: What is a pit puzzle parking system?
response.overview: A pit puzzle parking system is an automated parking solution installed partly or fully below ground level. It uses a combination of vertical and horizontal platform movement to park multiple vehicles in a limited area. This puzzle type parking system is useful for buildings where surface parking space is limited but underground space is available. The system can move parking platforms up, down, and sideways to bring the required vehicle to the entry or exit position. A pit puzzle parking system can provide more parking spaces without requiring a large surface area. Depending on the design, it can be used in residential buildings, commercial properties, offices, hospitals, and other projects where efficient parking is required. A hydraulic puzzle parking system may be used to lift and move platforms, while an automated puzzle parking system can use control panels and sensors to manage vehicle movement. The main benefit of a pit puzzle parking system is better use of available space.
